info.title: VeilGraph RightsGate
info.description: Evidence-first pre-publication media trust gateway derived from VeilGraph. The API exposes the inherited privacy foundation plus versioned RightsGate contracts, offline C2PA inspection, governed image retrieval, licence evaluation, deterministic policy and durable non-authorizing image assessments.
